models.name: gpt-image-2
models.script: const body={model,prompt,images:images||[],aspectRatio:String(params.aspectRatio||"auto")};const data=await request({method:"post",url:"/api/generate",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json",Authorization:"Bearer "+apiKey},data:body});if(data.status==="succeeded"&&(data.results||[]).length){const urls=data.results.map(o=>o.url).filter(Boolean);if(urls.length)return urls;}if(data.status==="running"&&data.id){try{return await poll(()=>request({method:"get",url:"/api/generate/query?id="+encodeURIComponent(data.id),headers:{Authorization:"Bearer "+apiKey}}),s=>s.status==="succeeded"?(s.results||[]).map(o=>o.url).filter(Boolean):null,{intervalMs:5000,timeoutMs:1200000});}catch(e){if(String(e.message||"").includes("404"))throw new Error("异步查询端点未配置，请用 replyType=json 同步模式");throw e;}}throw new Error(data.error||"生成失败:status="+data.status);

models.name: gpt-image-2-vip
models.script: const VIP_PIXELS={"1:1":["1024x1024","2048x2048","2880x2880"],"16:9":["1280x720","2048x1152","3840x2160"],"9:16":["720x1280","1152x2048","2160x3840"],"4:3":["1152x864","2304x1728","3264x2448"],"3:4":["864x1152","1728x2304","2448x3264"],"3:2":["1536x1024","2048x1360","3504x2336"],"2:3":["1024x1536","1360x2048","2336x3504"],"5:4":["1120x896","2240x1792","3200x2560"],"4:5":["896x1120","1792x2240","2560x3200"],"21:9":["1456x624","2912x1248","3840x1648"],"9:21":["624x1456","1248x2912","1648x3840"],"1:2":["768x1536","1536x3072","1920x3840"],"2:1":["1536x768","3072x1536","3840x1920"]};const RES_INDEX={"1K":0,"2K":1,"4K":2};const ratio=String(params.aspectRatio||"auto");const pixels=(VIP_PIXELS[ratio]||[])[RES_INDEX[String(params.resolution||"2K")]||1]||"2048x2048";const body={model,prompt,images:images||[],aspectRatio:pixels};const data=await request({method:"post",url:"/api/generate",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json",Authorization:"Bearer "+apiKey},data:body});if(data.status==="succeeded"&&(data.results||[]).length){const urls=data.results.map(o=>o.url).filter(Boolean);if(urls.length)return urls;}if(data.status==="running"&&data.id){try{return await poll(()=>request({method:"get",url:"/api/generate/query?id="+encodeURIComponent(data.id),headers:{Authorization:"Bearer "+apiKey}}),s=>s.status==="succeeded"?(s.results||[]).map(o=>o.url).filter(Boolean):null,{intervalMs:5000,timeoutMs:1200000});}catch(e){if(String(e.message||"").includes("404"))throw new Error("异步查询端点未配置，请用 replyType=json 同步模式");throw e;}}throw new Error(data.error||"生成失败:status="+data.status);
